name: AvatarSay MCP Server
description: Roll tabletop RPG/D&D NPCs with SillyTavern Card V2 and Foundry VTT Actor JSON exports, generate stylized fictional character portraits, synthesize MP3 NPC voice barks, and animate lip-synced 960x960 talking videos. Public discovery and roll_rpg_npc work with no API key.
author: fourgit

AVATARSAY_API_KEY.description: Optional AvatarSay API key (avs_...) required only for portrait, voice-bark, and talking-video generation; omit for public discovery and roll_rpg_npc.
